name: io.github.zsraduly77/defi-flow-price-gap
title: DeFi Capital Flow-Price Gap
description: Daily on-chain DeFi capital inflow vs token price, Bitcoin-timestamped. Free and x402-paid tools.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Free. Today's data day and its age, the quality gate, whether paid tools are open (paid_routes_open), the Bitcoin proof status of today's fingerprint, the token list (token_symbols) and each tier's track-record verdict. Same JSON as GET /v1/status. Informational, not investment advice.

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description: Free. Track record per signal tier: backtest verdicts (A works / B partial / C not distinguishable from luck) per methodology version, observation counts, the thresholds, Bitcoin proofs, the live record and the price policy. A tier name describes the measured state, not how well it is proven. Same JSON as GET /performance.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: Free. What is measured today: chains, protocols, tokens and data sets, generated from the data itself. Same JSON as GET /coverage.json.

tools.name: list_free_days
tools.description: Free. Every data day older than 7 days, free under CC BY 4.0 and byte-identical to the Bitcoin-timestamped originals: date, link to the full signal, fingerprint and Bitcoin status. Compact view of GET /free/index.json.

tools.name: get_free_signal
tools.description: Free. The full daily signal (all tokens: protocol capital inflow vs price gap, tier and reason, holder value fields, risk flag) of a data day older than 7 days, CC BY 4.0, with its proof fields. Argument date: YYYY-MM-DD (see list_free_days). Same JSON as GET /free/{date}/signal.json. Informational, not investment advice.

tools.name: get_proof
tools.description: Free. The SHA-256 fingerprint file and the OpenTimestamps Bitcoin proof of a data day, its Bitcoin status and block, and how to verify it yourself (ready-made code: /examples/). Argument date: YYYY-MM-DD. From GET /verify/index.json.

tools.name: get_token_signal
tools.description: One DeFi token (argument token): first-party on-chain TVL inflow/outflow vs price gap, tier + reason. All 10 tokens: /v1/signal $0.01. Bitcoin-timestamped; free proof: /verify/index.json. Informational, not investment advice. Track record per tier (A/B/C, rules fixed in advance and Bitcoin-timestamped) in every response; predictive power not yet proven live. Paid: $0.005 USDC on Base with x402 inside the MCP call (_meta["x402/payment"]); without payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired result and nothing is charged. Same JSON as GET /v1/signal/{token}.

token.description: token symbol (the list: get_status, field token_symbols)

receipt.description: optional: refetch.receipt from an earlier paid answer of the same tool - the same data again without payment (terms 2b)

tools.name: get_signal
tools.description: All 10 DeFi tokens on Ethereum, daily: first-party on-chain protocol TVL inflow/outflow (not resold) vs price gap; tiers + reasons. Bitcoin-timestamped; free proof: /verify/index.json. Informational, not investment advice. Track record per tier (A/B/C, rules fixed in advance and Bitcoin-timestamped) in every response; predictive power not yet proven live. Paid: $0.01 USDC on Base with x402 inside the MCP call (_meta["x402/payment"]); without payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired result and nothing is charged. Same JSON as GET /v1/signal.

receipt.description: optional: refetch.receipt from an earlier paid answer of the same tool - the same data again without payment (terms 2b)

tools.name: get_inflow_assets
tools.description: Asset-level protocol TVL inflow/outflow for 10 DeFi tokens on Ethereum: first-party on-chain reads at a fixed daily block. Bitcoin-timestamped; free proof: /verify/index.json. Informational, not investment advice. Paid: $0.02 USDC on Base with x402 inside the MCP call (_meta["x402/payment"]); without payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired result and nothing is charged. Same JSON as GET /v1/inflow/assets.

receipt.description: optional: refetch.receipt from an earlier paid answer of the same tool - the same data again without payment (terms 2b)

tools.name: get_holder_value
tools.description: Holder value for 10 DeFi tokens on Ethereum: revenue, burn, buyback, payouts, dilution and net, first-party on-chain. Bitcoin-timestamped; free proof: /verify/index.json. Informational, not investment advice. Paid: $0.02 USDC on Base with x402 inside the MCP call (_meta["x402/payment"]); without payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired result and nothing is charged. Same JSON as GET /v1/holder-value.

receipt.description: optional: refetch.receipt from an earlier paid answer of the same tool - the same data again without payment (terms 2b)
